command:
set -euo pipefail
NS=m19p1local
echo "external=$RICCON_TEST_SERVICES namespace=$NS compose=$(docker compose version --short)"
node scripts/test-services.mjs prepare --namespace "$NS"
RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE="$NS" perl -e 'alarm shift; exec @ARGV' 1500 ./mvnw -q -T1C verify
node scripts/test-timings.mjs --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p1-timings"
node --check scripts/test-services.mjs
ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); puts "yaml ok"'
git diff --check
note: 外部证据：P1 CI 热栈本地全量。external=external namespace=m19p1local compose=5.7.1；命令含 prepare + RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external ./mvnw -q -T1C verify（25 分钟硬超时）+ test-timings + node --check + YAML 校验 + git diff --check；CI 本身尚未在 GitHub Actions 运行。
